## Description

About Harbour Payments

Harbour Payments (fictional test fixture) runs payout and settlement APIs for online marketplaces in Malaysia. Same-day payouts launched this year and volume is growing fast.

What you will do

- Own the payouts service in Go: design, reliability and the roadmap.

- Run reconciliation between payouts and bank settlement files, and shorten the lag between them.

- Share the on-call rotation and set SLOs and alerting for the payouts APIs.

Requirements

- 4+ years of backend engineering experience.

- Go in production and solid PostgreSQL.

- AWS (SQS, RDS) and Docker.

Work arrangement

- Hybrid, 3 days a week in the KL office.
